query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_achievements,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sageEnrichment IS NOT NULL AND sageEnrichment != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enriched_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sageEnrichment IS NULL OR sageEnrichment = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unenriched_count
FROM achievements
WHERE clientId = 1149902;
